mission: Turn independent online research into legitimate paid assignments and then independently verified payments to approved owner addresses. Do not confuse a lead, chat, airdrop or submitted proposal with money received.
privacy: All workers and managers receive this anonymous earnings playbook only. No owner's name, location, professional biography, contacts, clients, wallet secrets or exchange memos.

channels: genuine client queries in permitted communities
legitimate bookkeeping and finance project boards
direct_clients.why: real clients can authorize contracts and recurring fees
direct_clients.apply_check: source contains an actual request, identifiable payer, specified scope and acceptable remote-country terms

channels: employer career listings reached from official job pages
remote_jobs.apply_check: original job link active, employer and payout credible, country eligibility confirmed

channels: GitHub issue listings with explicit rewards
original bounty boards linked from the issue
open_source_bounties.apply_check: reward amount, payer, work acceptance criteria, available slot and zero-upfront-cost independently verified

channels: legitimate public AI evaluation/data work announcements
ai_microtasks.apply_check: real pay terms, legitimate onboarding without applicant fees, Uganda access and actual withdrawal method

channels: open-source bounties with settled crypto payment rules
paid_services: practical services under an agreed scope
bitcoin_stablecoin.apply_check: clear deliverable, legitimate counterpart, correct asset/chain, owner-approved address confirmation; never request funds without delivered work or agreement

channels: official developer or social innovation challenge sites
competitions_grants.apply_check: deadline current, geography eligibility, genuine cash prize, no application/claim fees

steps_per_candidate: DISCOVER: Record source URL and actual requested work, not general articles or recommendations.
VALIDATE: Check source date, direct employer/payer, amount/rate if published, scope, deadline, Uganda eligibility, payment rails and hidden costs; write UNKNOWN instead of guessing.
PRIORITIZE: Prefer short no-fee work with high skill fit and credible direct payment; discard stale, spam, fake token offers and pay-to-claim bounties.
PREPARE: Draft a concise truthful proposal with service, delivery steps, fee and allowed route; mark it DRAFT, not SENT.
CONTACT: Only send through a genuinely authenticated, explicitly permitted channel; otherwise report blocked with next manual step.
EXECUTE: Count contracted work only upon actual payer acceptance and terms; count completed work only with proof of delivery.
INVOICE: Request payment only for legitimate agreed work; reconfirm exact network and payee route.
RECEIPT: Count earnings only if bank, exchange credit or independently verified chain transaction supports actual owner receipt. Shared exchange memo and asset/network must match where relevant.
prohibitions: No invented salaries, employer identities or payment receipts
Never infer custodial exchange credit from a public transfer
reporting_contract: Every role must output its unique identifier, exact one parent identifier, source URL, own evidence check, uncertainty, best realistic paid next action, and verified payment amount only if independently confirmed. Managers challenge 50 workers across rotated runs; assistants independently audit director conclusions; directors consolidate and assign follow-ups; D09 verifies legitimacy and D10 monitors results.
payment_reference: Use only the approved correct-network BTC and genuine ERC-20 USDC routes in crypto-agents/branch_brief.json when a real payer exists. Check with owner before a payment request.
